ops.text: (c) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Contractor shall (i) at Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Contractor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Company all Company data, Works and Confidential Information in Contractor's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all such data, Works and Confidential Information from its systems and certify such deletion to Company in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit provision: up to six months of transition assistance at Contractor's then-current rates, return of our data and Works in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter. The Agreement currently has no data-return or wind-down mechanic, and we can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback.
input.summary: Insert transition assistance, data return and certified deletion obligation in Section 6 (Termination).
